summary: Consent or pay / tracking walls / no-privacy-by-tribute revision adding a rule that righteousness is burdened when behavioural-tracking consent or a fee paid to avoid that tracking becomes the practical price of ordinary digital participation rather than a genuinely equivalent less-intrusive alternative.
adds: a new canon doc on consent or pay, tracking walls, and no-privacy-by-tribute
overview, working-theory, office, method, and failure-mode updates clarifying the difference between bounded funding choices and governance through no-privacy-by-tribute
four compact official source additions on current EDPB, ICO, and European Commission materials for consent-or-pay, tracking, equivalence, and less-personalised alternatives
a new open question on when online funding arrangements remain genuinely bounded and when they instead become no-privacy-by-tribute
